reading.body:
Vantage WA13 is one building in a three-building Quincy campus that totals 89 MW of critical IT load and 775,000 square feet, per Vantage's own specification page. The individual building's capacity is not published. At a typical AI training density of 40 kW per rack, the full campus would accommodate roughly 2,200 racks, though this figure spreads across three separate data centers and may include non-AI workloads.

Washington State has 46 mapped data center facilities, of which only 2 publish power figures. The Quincy campus ranks third among published capacity in the state and represents one-third of the 60 MW of published critical IT load across Washington. The other 44 mapped facilities in the state do not publish power figures and could be smaller, offline, or reserved for unreported purposes.

No certifications, pending capacity expansion, redundancy tier, or water and cooling infrastructure are published for this specific building or the Quincy campus. The site is in Grant County, an area of significant hydropower availability, but grid constraints and interconnection timelines for this campus are not published.
